Saturation and value are kept constant for colour mapping and can be used for lighting effects. If the hue is uniquely defined by a one-to-one mapping, the mapping is invertible, even when lighting is applied.' This confirms that by isolating hue from saturation and value (which are affected by lighting), the semantic mapping of hue remains intact and invertible.
